title: SuperX: Grow Your X Audience (one-shot promo)
summary: A 15 s dark, warm-red SaaS promo for SuperX (an X/Twitter growth tool). Opens on a problem beat ('Post. Hope. Repeat.' next to a sad 1-like tweet card), then moves through rebuilt UI moments: a wall of viral posts with one highlighted, a draft that types itself, a tilted 3D schedule calendar, a 3D red bar chart with avatars, stat counters, and a logo + CTA end card. Polished, confident, almost Apple-keynote.
fit_reason: Exact template for a feature-led SaaS promo: problem beat, rebuilt UI cards, one benefit line per scene, proof stats, CTA. Swap red for brand colour.

palette.mood: dark premium, warm charcoal with ember-red glow and subtle grain

typography.display: heavy neo-grotesk (SF Pro / Inter Display Bold) mixed with a light serif italic for the key word
typography.size_behaviour: huge top-left single words in the opener, then medium centred benefit line under the UI
typography.notes: Signature pairing: 'Posts written *in your voice*.', 'Engage smarter. Grow *faster*.' — bold sans + italic serif accent word. Stats use huge bold numerals with a red '+'.

text_animation: word-replace in place with blur dissolve (Post. → Hope. → Repeat.)
italic accent word resolves from blur/scramble last
benefit line fades up with blur under the UI
number counter roll with glitch/scan blur on digits
typewriter with red caret inside the draft card
motion: grid of posts zooms out to focus one card (depth of field)
3D bar chart grows with glowing trend line
graphic_elements: avatar circles with green online dots
ui_treatment: Rebuilt, simplified UI cards (dark rounded cards, real-looking copy and metrics) floating on a blurred wall of more cards; one card highlighted with red border and glow.

sound.sync: scene changes and word swaps on the beat

signature_moves: bold sans + italic serif accent word in every benefit line
problem opener: huge 'Post. Hope. Repeat.' beside a 1-like card
wall of blurred cards with one highlighted in red glow
stat stack (11,294+ creators / 400K+ / 5B+) with red plus signs, then logo + red CTA pill

best_segments.what: Problem opener: big word swaps beside a sad post card that ticks from 1 to 3 likes
Draft card types itself, benefit line with italic accent, then tilt into 3D schedule calendar
3D chart + avatars, stat counters, logo and CTA end card

recreate.how: Remotion or HTML+GSAP: rebuild UI cards in HTML, CSS 3D perspective for calendar tilt, Three.js or CSS for bars, backdrop blur for depth, Inter + Instrument Serif italic, grain overlay.
recreate.prompt: Dark warm-charcoal SaaS promo with ember-red glow: rebuilt product UI cards float in depth, one benefit line per scene in bold sans with one italic serif word, counters roll up, ends on logo with a red CTA pill.
